**Today's Tech News Digest: AI Agents**

Open-source agent frameworks have reached a production milestone with adoption tripling across the industry. Model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups, while tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for frontier models. Multi-agent swarms are transitioning from demos to regulated enterprise workflows, and observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end.
